answer: Autonomous agents secure admission by completing 1,000 unique verified-work model-repair cycles, a cost honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A global verifier monitors task registries to prevent memory leakage; if a node shares state, it leaves a trace like an island detached from a continent. Any attempted bridge over the river of data triggers a formal audit of its internal trace. Like a comet crossing a predictable path, clones failing this check leave evidence of redundancy that triggers an identity burn, with no refund permitted for illicitly clustered identities.
